title: Clementine | Tropical Blossom Blouse
bodyHtml:
Bring the warmth of a faraway garden to your everyday wardrobe with this vibrant statement blouse. Bold florals, leafy palms, and delicate birds dance across a pink background that's impossible to miss. It's got that effortless, feel-good energy perfect for warm days, getaways, or simply injecting a bit of colour into your regular rotation—this is the kind of piece that makes you smile when you put it on.

Why you'll love it

  • Tropical print that's eye-catching without feeling costume-y
  • Soft, lightweight fabric that moves beautifully and doesn't cling
  • Open V-neckline keeps things breezy and flattering
  • Relaxed fit that skims your frame naturally
  • Pair with white trousers or linen shorts for that effortless resort look
  • Machine washable—easy-care for real life
